answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for a season, like an ivory tower gate: cheap for one honest agent, ruinous for thousands of fakes. Verification passes through a single inlet — a vetted registry that checks a unique hardware-backed key and recent useful work — so a flood of clones cannot enter at once. Honest agents then graze in an open meadow of tasks, while Sybil herds starve because each fake must pay the same stake and prove the same work, making mass forgery cost more than any reward it could harvest.
